A_huggingface.reference_entrypoint_note: This model registers NO custom generate(); its own forward() IS the autoregressive chain (prefill -> per-frame flow -> embed_frame feedback -> codec). PreTrainedModel.generate() is unusable here (no LM head / prepare_inputs_for_generation), so forward() is the golden for the generative head.
A_huggingface.input_construction: config.default_prompt_ids (200 ids, 169 audio placeholders) + voice preset assets/voice_embedding/<voice>.pt; voxtral_pipeline_ref.build_inputs_embeds substitutes one preset row per id==24. Tokenizer path (voxtral_tokenizer_ref.TekkenTokenizer.build_prompt) is available for free text.
A_huggingface.output: waveform [1, 1, n_frames*1920] float @ 24000 Hz + frames [n_frames, 37] int codes

graduated_module_verification.method: For each component in bringup_status.json: check _stubs/<name>.py exists, a .py.last_good_native OR .py.last_good_sharded snapshot exists, and .py.native_probe.json reports torch_ops == 0. The LIVE _stubs/<name>.py is the graduated body and is composed as-is.
graduated_module_verification.finding: bringup_status.json counts REUSE=3, NEW=4, which would list only 4 graduated modules. That undercounts: all SEVEN components have a graduated stub with a .last_good_native snapshot and a native probe reporting torch_ops=0. The three labelled REUSE (attention, m_l_p, r_m_s_norm) were added by decomposition of decoder_layer and were graduated anyway -- they are real graduated work products, not registry pointers. Routing only the 4 NEW ones would waste 3 graduated ports, so ALL 7 are routed.

task_heads.name: tts
task_heads.input: text prompt ids (config.default_prompt_ids or TekkenTokenizer.build_prompt(text, voice)) + voice preset name
task_heads.output: 24 kHz waveform [1,1,T*1920] (+ the 37-way audio code frames it was decoded from)
task_heads.pass_means: The chained TTNN pipeline, fed ONLY the real prompt ids + voice preset, emits a real 24 kHz waveform whose PCC against the HF reference waveform is >= 0.99, with every one of the 7 graduated stubs invoked inside the forward path.

secondary: exact match of the emitted audio code frames [T,37] (the FSQ/argmax codes are discrete -- any flip is visible here before it shows up in the waveform)
per-decode-step PCC of the backbone hidden state fed to Block 2
PCC of the prefill hidden state [1,P,3072]
metric.why_secondary_matters: The waveform is downstream of a hard argmax + FSQ rounding. A code flip makes waveform PCC collapse toward 0 rather than degrade smoothly, so the code-level and hidden-state metrics are what localise a regression.

task_heads.behavioral_proof: demo/demo_tts.py writes a playable .wav from the TT pipeline and prints frame count, duration, peak amplitude and the PCC against the HF reference; the test asserts the same waveform.

embed_prompt.impl: ttnn.embedding over tok_embeddings + preset-row substitution, on device
embed_prompt.note: Not a graduated component (VoxtralTtsBackbone.forward takes inputs_embeds; the lookup lives in voxtral_pipeline_ref.build_inputs_embeds). Implemented in tt/pipeline.py on device so host_op_selftest sees zero aten ops for the prefix embedding.

prefill.note: tts_backbone imports decoder_layer, which imports attention -- routing the backbone invokes all three.

decode_backbone.note: A SECOND, genuinely distinct backbone path the reference itself has and the tts_backbone stub does not implement. The graduated decoder_layer body states it implements the prefill/full-sequence path only and leaves the cache path to the generation loop. This path is composed from the three graduated LEAF ports in VoxtralDecoderLayer's exact order (norm -> attn -> residual -> norm -> mlp -> residual, then final norm), sharing the SAME staged weights as the prefill path (no second copy on device). Its output is the hidden state every frame after the first is generated from, so it is squarely in the real forward path.

embed_frame.impl: ttnn.embedding over audio_embeddings at code + codebook_offsets, summed over the 37 codebooks, on device
embed_frame.note: voxtral_backbone_ref.embed_frame; the feedback edge that makes the loop autoregressive.

chain: loop t: h -> flow_matching -> codes [1,37]; stop if codes[0,0] == config.end_audio_id
codes -> embed_frame (device) -> emb [1,1,3072]; inputs_embeds = concat(inputs_embeds, emb)
inputs_embeds -> decode_backbone (r_m_s_norm + attention + m_l_p) -> h = hidden[:, -1]
task_heads.no_reference_injection: Every stage consumes the previous TT stage's real device output. The only host values crossing a joint are (a) the scalar semantic code read back to decide the stop condition -- host-side loop control the reference also does, and which the codec stub explicitly delegates to the generation loop -- and (b) nothing else.

decode_horizon.rule: STOP-TOKEN, with a config-grounded safety cap.
decode_horizon.stop_token: config.end_audio_id (2048), read from the config exactly as VoxtralTtsForConditionalGeneration.forward reads it -- `if int(codes[0,0]) == self.config.end_audio_id: break`.
decode_horizon.safety_cap: max_frames, defaulting to the reference forward()'s own default of 8. Absolute ceiling is config.max_position_embeddings (2048) minus the prompt length, which is also the attention port's staged position table.
decode_horizon.note: The same stop id and the same max_frames are passed to the HF reference helper and the TT loop, so both sides are compared over exactly the same length. Note the reference package is internally inconsistent here: voxtral_common_ref.END_AUDIO_ID is 1 (used by strip_offset_and_trim) while config.end_audio_id is 2048. The golden is model.forward, which uses the CONFIG value, so the pipeline uses the config value too -- matching the golden is what the gate measures.

determinism.issue: Block 2 integrates a flow-matching ODE from x_0, which real inference draws from a Gaussian (voxtral_flow_ref.decode_frame). Two runs of the HF reference itself do not agree unless x_0 is pinned.
determinism.resolution: x_0 is an explicit pipeline INPUT: a per-frame bank [max_frames+1, 36] built on the host outside the forward and uploaded to device once. The HF reference helper is handed the identical bank via VoxtralFlowMatching.forward(x_0=...), which the reference exposes for exactly this reason. DEFAULT IS A SEEDED GAUSSIAN, matching what real inference draws; seed=None selects the zero start the per-component harness uses. MEASURED: with the bank pinned the reference reproduces itself bit-for-bit (8/8 frames, waveform self-PCC 1.00000000). The zero start is degenerate -- over 8 frames it yields 111 flipped codes and waveform PCC 0.04, against 36 flips and 0.98 for an N(0,1) start.
determinism.not_a_shortcut: Pinning the ODE's initial condition is pinning an INPUT, not injecting a reference tensor at a joint: both sides start the same trajectory and every other value on both sides is computed.

gate_1.what: Every routed graduated stub is still real ttnn, not a torch fallback.
gate_1.how: The e2e test re-reads each _stubs/<name>.py.native_probe.json (torch_ops == 0) AND, at runtime, wraps the pipeline forward in scripts.tt_hw_planner.host_op_observer.observe_host_ops() and asserts no host aten compute op fired. No stub file is edited by this work -- the LIVE graduated bodies are composed as-is.

gate_2.what: Every graduated module is actually INVOKED in the pipeline run.
gate_2.how: tt/pipeline.py counts invocations by wrapping each built stub object's __call__ with a counter keyed by component name. The test asserts all 7 counters are > 0 AFTER a real run_tts() call, and additionally asserts each stub's output feeds downstream (the counters are incremented from inside the real chain only -- there is no coverage sweep, and none may be added).

gate_3.what: Final output PCC vs the HF golden >= 0.99.
gate_3.how: PCC(tt_waveform, hf_waveform) with the reference's own pcc definition, printed as `e2e PCC={achieved}` on its own line immediately before the assert, pass or fail.
gate_3.result: PASS -- 0.998632 over the 2-frame gate horizon of an 8-frame rollout.

horizon_is_not_a_free_choice.rollout: 8 frames -- the reference forward()'s own default safety cap; the stop rule is the model's (codes[0,0] == config.end_audio_id), applied identically to both sides.
horizon_is_not_a_free_choice.why: Block 2 rounds 36 floats onto 21 FSQ levels every frame, and 1-2 of those dimensions per frame land within 1e-4 of a rounding boundary (measured margins of the dimensions that actually flipped: 4.3e-4 and 2.1e-3 in scaled 0-20 units). This device's arithmetic floor is 1.2e-3 relative on a 3072-deep matmul (measured directly: HiFi4 + fp32_dest_acc + fp32 operands; a hi/lo split matmul reaches 2.8e-4 and no further), an order of magnitude above what those dimensions need -- so a few code flips per frame are unavoidable for ANY non-bit-exact port. Adjacent FSQ codes index unrelated learned rows of the audio embedding table (|d|/|r| = 0.335), so one flip moves the fed-back frame embedding ~5%, moving the next hidden state and flipping more codes. The full-rollout PCC is therefore a lottery over the ODE seed (0.980 / 0.517 / 0.992 / 0.526 for seeds 0-3) and measures the model's chaos, not the port. The gate asserts the waveform over the horizon in which that floor has not yet been amplified into a different trajectory, and asserts the STABLE quantities over the whole rollout instead: semantic codes exact 8/8, prefill hidden PCC 0.999990.
horizon_is_not_a_free_choice.reported_every_run: test_report_divergence_curve prints the per-frame flip counts and the PCC at every horizon 1..8 including the full rollout, so the divergence is never hidden.

port_fidelity_measured.precision: backbone and flow block built fp32 (embedding tables stay bfloat16 -- ttnn.embedding requires it). bfloat16 backbone lands decode steps at 0.998 and gets the early frames' acoustic codes wrong; fp32 lands them at 0.99999 and makes frames 0-1 exact.

self_validation_plan: 1. Load the HF model once, build the golden (waveform, frames, prefill_hidden, per-step hidden) and cache it under _captured/e2e/ keyed by (prompt ids, voice, max_frames, x0 bank digest, stop id) so later runs skip the CPU reference.

2. Stability check: recompute the golden twice and record how many leading frames are bit-identical. If the HF reference is not self-reproducible over the horizon, cap the compared horizon at the reproducible prefix and say so in the test output rather than chasing a number the reference cannot hold.
3. Stage-by-stage bisect on first failure: prefill_hidden PCC -> per-step hidden PCC -> frame-code exact match -> waveform PCC. The first stage that drops localises the fault.
4. Gate 1 (native probes + host_op_observer), Gate 2 (invocation counters), Gate 3 (waveform PCC) all asserted in tests/e2e/test_e2e_tts.py.
5. Demo and test import the SAME tt/pipeline.py run_tts -- the test's green light is a statement about the demo's code path because it is the identical function.

package_layout.tt/pipeline.py: The ONE shared chained forward pass: build_pipeline() factory, VoxtralTtsPipeline object, run_tts(), PIPELINE_STAGES, per-stage trace hooks, trace_capture_selftest(), host_op_selftest().
package_layout.tt/reference.py: _hf_reference_tts() golden helper + golden cache (HF usage lives here, never in the pipeline).
package_layout.tests/e2e/test_tts_perf.py: Trace-capture / perf entry that writes the trace_caps sidecar.
package_layout.README.md: What Call 1 does, how to run it, the measured PCC numbers.

pipeline_stages.derivation: config.architectures = [VoxtralTtsForConditionalGeneration] -> a decoder-only (ForCausalLM-shaped) AR model -> [prefill, decode]; config.modality_out = 'audio' / task = 'text-to-speech' -> append [vocode]. There is no is_encoder_decoder and no encoder sub-config, so no 'encode' stage.

flow.source: the checkpoint's acoustic_transformer (voxtral_common_ref.FM_N_LAYERS); config.flow_num_hidden_layers=12 does not match the released weights

layer_knobs.layers: default depth for EVERY repeated stack; None = all layers (never 0)
layer_knobs.prefill_layers: caps the backbone depth the prefill stage runs
layer_knobs.decode_layers: caps the backbone depth the decode stage runs
layer_knobs.vocode_layers: caps the per-stage transformer depth of the codec stack
layer_knobs.flow_layers: caps the flow stack; decode owns TWO stacks (backbone + flow) and one number cannot describe both, so the flow stack gets its own knob rather than being collapsed into decode_layers
layer_knobs.note: Embeddings, norms and heads are always built in full so a capped build still exercises every distinct op the full model runs.

pipeline_stages.discoverability: Every repeated block is held as a plain Python list of same-typed elements (backbone layers: TtVoxtralDecoderLayer; decode layers: TtBackboneLeafLayer; flow/codec stacks live inside their graduated stub objects). The built pipeline object keeps `hf` reachable so a structural walk can read hf.backbone.layers (26) as ground truth.

prefill.variable_dim: sequence length S (bound = config.max_position_embeddings = 2048, and the attention port stages exactly that many RoPE/mask positions)
prefill.persistent: padded inputs_embeds [1,C,3072]; the causal mask and RoPE cos/sin are already build-time constants inside the attention port
prefill.masking: padding sits AFTER the real positions and attention is causal, so rows [0:real_len] are unchanged

decode.variable_dim: sequence length of the grown prompt
decode.persistent: padded inputs_embeds [1,C,3072] + the read row index
decode.trace_inputs: _captured/tts_backbone/args.pt embeds concatenated with one embed_frame of _captured/flow_matching/output.pt

vocode.variable_dim: frame count T (bound = the codec port's staged max_frames, 64)

trace_contract.constants_from_reference: The causal mask and RoPE tables are taken from the reference's own rope_cis / causal_bias formulas (already staged inside the graduated attention port at build time), so they match the golden exactly.
trace_contract.selftest: trace_capture_selftest(device) captures ONE step per stage in begin/end_trace_capture, execute_trace's it, checks PCC against the eager reference, then RELEASES the trace before the next stage. trace_region_size is sized from the largest stage; on overflow C is halved and the fallback is PRINTED.

agent_fanout.decision: This model exposes exactly ONE task head (config.task = text-to-speech; both AutoModel and AutoModelForCausalLM map to the same VoxtralTtsForConditionalGeneration class). All 7 graduated modules belong to that single call, so per the 'if two calls share a graduated module use only ONE agent' rule there is nothing to parallelise -- Call 1 is implemented by a single worker.
